blurb: Daniel Romero writes HyperTechInvest, a Substack-hosted research letter focused on long-term tech investing with a heavy semiconductor and AI supply-chain bias. His recurring themes include identifying "bottlenecks" in the chip stack — glass substrates, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, optical networking — and surfacing under-followed small- and mid-cap names with exposure to those choke points. The publication claims north of 7,000 readers and runs a model portfolio with periodic holdings updates. Romero's voice on X (@HyperTechInvest) is brief and promotional, often paired with stock-card screenshots celebrating moves in his published names.
credibility_note: A paid newsletter author with a clear book of disclosed positions. His semiconductor calls are research-driven rather than day-trade signals, but the format is advocacy: posts highlight winners and rarely revisit losers in the same medium. Treat as informed sector commentary, not independent analysis.
